slices.title: See results
slices.summary: Replaces the permanently disabled See results button in ScheduledRunsPanel with an expander of the last five fires (time, status, outcome, origin chip, withheld count, transcript link), backed by a listScheduleFires client call, a schedule.fires.list action contract, a gateway route and a model-gateway proxy for GET /v1/cron/{id}/fires.

slices.title: Characterisation goldens and ledger entries
slices.summary: Pins the Do tool catalogue (each offered tool with trusted_capability_id, rung_required_for and is_risky_tool) and the 8 model-eligible ids as golden tests, records the DEC-24 and DEC-25 decisions and the never-promote rule in the decisions ledger, and corrects the stale workspace_hydrate.rs header. Docs and tests only; no runtime change.
